narratives.body: NBC Sports reports Bradley Beal is ruled out against Sacramento due to a knee injury and remains unavailable for the Lakers game. The outlet states Beal (knee) is ruled out vs. Sacramento and remains out vs. Lakers.
narratives.headline: Bradley Beal (knee) ruled out vs. Sacramento

narratives.body: ABC30 Fresno reports the Los Angeles Clippers are indicating that Chris Paul's old No. 3 jersey will be retired for Bradley Beal. The article states the Clippers indicate Chris Paul's old No. 3 going to Bradley Beal.
narratives.headline: Clippers indicate Chris Paul's old No. 3 going to Bradley Beal
